1.consolidated_definition: Pelo largo sedoso del gato sic de Angora o tejido hecho con este pelo. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Echarpe de lana y mohair marca “ pertegaz “, composición : 53 % lana, 23 % acrilico, 16 % angora, 4 % mohair, 4% poliamida y medidas en cm. 140 x 4. !! Nuevo con etiquetas (Kosasway, consultado 02-06-09)
1.en_consolidated_definition: The long, silky hair of the Angora cat or a fabric made from this hair. A crude Anglicism, infrequently used. Shawl made of wool and mohair under the "Pertegaz" brand, composition: 53% wool, 23% acrylic, 16% angora, 4% mohair, 4% polyamide, and measurements in cm. 140 x 4. New with labels (Kosasway, consulted on 02-06-09).
